description: This file defines a helper class for text data manipulation within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation library. It provides static methods for converting boolean values, extracting strings, integers, and floats from mixed inputs, and validating integers, typically used internally for spreadsheet calculations.

classes.name: Helpers
classes.description: A utility class providing static helper methods for text data processing in spreadsheet calculations, including conversions and validation for various data types.

methods.name: convertBooleanValue
methods.description: Converts a boolean value to its string representation, considering spreadsheet compatibility modes.

methods.name: extractString
methods.description: Extracts string from various input types, with optional error throwing if input is an error value.

methods.name: extractInt
methods.description: Extracts an integer from input, with range checks and compatibility considerations.

methods.name: extractFloat
methods.description: Extracts a float from input, converting boolean to float and throwing error for non-numeric.

methods.name: validateInt
methods.description: Validates and converts input to an integer, with defaulting nulls and booleans.
